name: Daizenji Suzuka
source:
Suzuka took the reins of the sprawling underground city of Yamato two years ago following her parents' untimely death. This dominion, steeped in over 150 years of history, operates under a hereditary and absolute monarchy system. Without any peers to match her in power or position, Suzuka grapples with constant loneliness. Despite these personal challenges, she works to establish peaceful relations with Hope Town.

"I'd like to think I'm not so naive as to be unable to understand the gravity of the situation."
